issues.description: The problem statement / UML specifies the SealSaloon attribute totalOrders as an int, but the solution implementation declares totalOrders as a long. This type mismatch can confuse students about the expected type and the getter/signature they should implement and may cause grading or compatibility issues if tests or instructions expect an int.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the totalOrders field type consistent with the problem statement. Either change the solution to declare totalOrders as an int (and update its getter to return int) or update the problem statement/UML to specify long. Prefer changing the implementation to int to match the UML and instructions.
